notes.title: NewImages is over! Thanks for coming!
notes.notes: Thanks for showing up, we hope you had a blast! We'll be back with more festivals!

notes.title: Thanks and see you soon!
notes.notes:
Thank you all for attending the New Images festival! 
We'll be back with more exciting festivals soon!

notes.title: Cannes XR is over, NewImages Festival coming June 7th / 8th!
notes.notes: Cannes XR is over! We hope you had fun! While the Cannes Selection is gone, we'll have the New Images Festival Selection coming June 7th/8th so stay tuned!

notes.title: Launch of Alexandria - Port of Worlds
notes.notes:
[b]Step through the arches of time into a place of discovery, wonder and awe.[/b]
Alexandria is a new, visionary virtual space to showcase the official xR selection of the @Cannes XR and @NewImages Festival within a social, accessible, experience oriented environment.
